versions.content: If a SOME/IP segment is successfully received with Offset Field> 0, the SOME/IP TP module shall compare the received SOME/IP header fields with the values of the stored SOME/IP header fields which has been received with the first segment (i.e. Offset was set to 0): • Request ID [32 bit] • Protocol Version [8 bit] • Interface Version [8 bit] • Message Type [8 bit] • Return Code [8 bit] If these values match restart the SomeIpTpRxTimeoutTime and continue with the as- sembly process.
